dedupe_keys.name: simulated trading oligopoly response in electricity markets storm

description: Simulated Trading & Oligopoly Response in Electricity Markets (STORM) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Institute of Energy Economics at the University of Cologne (EWI). Compute electricity market equilibria in an interconnected multi-zone system, accounting for oligopolistic market power (via conjectural variations) and flow-based grid constraints (FBMC/PTDF). Not a cost-minimization dispatch; it solves for strategic firm behavior and resulting prices simultaneously. Coverage: Germany, United Kingdom, Ukraine. Methodical focus: Equilibrium Power Marketmodel, Cournot-Fringe Competition. Time resolution: hour. Spatial resolution: national states, TSO regions. Software: GAMS. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
